api.clock: 16 kHz PCM sample counter drives all idle motion
api.purity: pure function of (keyframe, clock); integer-only; no allocation
api.wasm_identity: verified: emcc build passes the same golden CRC32 table as native (tools/build.sh wasm)
api.optional_stage: fmg_coart_t caller-owned coarticulation filter (Cohen-Massaro-style dominance, articulator-weighted one-pole easing)

renderers.name: Preston Blair sprites
renderers.description: Eleven original 26x14 mouth cels following the classic Preston Blair ten-shape chart (Rhubarb A-F + G/H/X semantics), picked by a nearest-anchor viseme classifier, blitted 2x over a warm cartoon face with oval eyes, blush, and thick brows.

renderers.name: EGA talkie flap
renderers.description: CD-talkie era amplitude ladder: four chunky mouth cels plus round and pressed variants, strict EGA 16-color palette, 4px block face, pupils stepping in whole blocks.

renderers.name: Manga snap
renderers.description: White line-art anime face: ten mouth cels chosen with quantized snap timing, shine-dotted irises, happy arch blinks, blush strokes, thinking sweat drop, shout emphasis lines.

renderers.name: Flip-dot matrix
renderers.description: 32x24 two-state flip-disc board: viseme glyph font mouth, lit-disc eyes with punched pupils, dim brow bars, one-dot mechanical sway shifts, breathing status dot. Amber on black.

renderers.name: JALI jaw-lip polygon
renderers.description: Mouth rebuilt per frame from the two JALI axes (JA jaw gated by bilabial press, LI lip articulation) as four quadratic bezier envelopes per column; skull-pinned upper teeth, jaw-riding lower teeth, L/N tongue raise, philtrum, chin crease, nasolabial folds on wide smiles.

renderers.name: Bezier ribbon lips
renderers.description: Stage-show glossy lips as bezier ribbons with a cupid's bow (two mirrored quadratics), per-column thickness-gradient shading, specular sweep, teeth glint, corner dimples, deterministic sparkle; crescent eyes above.

renderers.name: Origami mask
renderers.description: Low-poly papercraft mask: 27 flat-shaded facets with fold creases; jaw facets hinge and darken as they rotate from the light; hexagonal mouth hole with paper-teeth zigzag, pursed-fold diamond for rounding, crease-shut press; backlit angular eye slits.

renderers.name: Teeth & tongue closeup
renderers.description: Extreme closeup where the mouth fills the frame: correct occlusion (upper teeth pinned, lower ride the jaw), gum lines, per-tooth rounding, grooved lifting tongue, throat depth gradient, swinging uvula on wide vowels; squinting eyes at the top edge.

renderers.name: LED VU mouth
renderers.description: KITT-style voicebox: three mirrored red segment columns (center taller) driven by openness with width-weighted flanks, rounding pulls columns together, bilabial press kills the bars, deterministic speaking shimmer, idle scanner-sweep homage; amber LED cluster eyes on a screwed bezel.

renderers.name: Oscilloscope trace
renderers.description: Phosphor XY-scope face: Lissajous ring eyes that flatten when blinking, a synthesized mouth waveform (amplitude=open, spatial frequency rises with frication, hash noise for sibilants, dead-flat on press) that closes into a rotating ellipse for rounded vowels; three phase-offset persistence passes; sweeping heartbeat blip in silence.

tests.suite: test/test_fmg.c (3456 checks: ABI, registry, arg validation, determinism, full-frame coverage, guard-band overflow, 13200-frame fuzz, idle-motion behavior, viseme classifier, coarticulation, golden CRC32)
tests.sprites: tools/check_sprites.py validates all 37 ASCII cel arrays
tests.wasm: tools/build.sh wasm proves native/wasm byte identity

performance_note: Host (Apple Silicon) worst case 33 us/frame (dot-matrix). With a conservative 100x ESP32-S3 derating that is ~3.3 ms/frame, comfortably inside the 33 ms 30 fps budget; all arithmetic is int32 with rare int64 intermediates.
